threads.summary_zh: 加拿大六大银行正联合探索代币化加元存款系统，第一阶段聚焦银行间代币化存款转移，并计划未来向其他存款机构和数字资产系统开放。
threads.summary_en: Canada’s Big Six banks are jointly exploring a tokenized Canadian dollar deposit system, with the first phase focused on interbank tokenized deposit transfers and longer-term plans to open it to other deposit-taking institutions and potentially other digital asset systems.
threads.latest_update_zh: 报道披露参与银行为 BMO、CIBC、National Bank of Canada、RBC、Scotiabank 和 TD Bank Group，并称第一阶段将聚焦银行间代币化存款转移，未来可能连接其他数字资产系统；同时提及 OSFI 于 9 月 10 日澄清代币化存款法律性质。
threads.latest_update_en: The report identifies the participating banks as BMO, CIBC, National Bank of Canada, RBC, Scotiabank and TD Bank Group, says the first phase will focus on moving tokenized deposits between Canadian financial institutions before possibly connecting with other digital asset systems, and cites OSFI's Sept. 10 clarification on the legal treatment of tokenized deposits.

threads.title_zh: Coldcard exploiter moves 45% of funds stolen from ‘Wave 3’ attacks, Galaxy says
threads.title_en: Coldcard exploiter moves 45% of funds stolen from ‘Wave 3’ attacks, Galaxy says
threads.summary_zh: Coldcard黑客事件后续出现白帽恢复行动：52.37枚比特币已被转移至恢复信托地址，受害者可通过指定网站查询；攻击者的洗钱活动仍在进行，但部分资金已被白帽拦截并进入恢复流程。
threads.summary_en: The Coldcard hack aftermath now includes whitehat recovery efforts: 52.37 BTC has been moved to a recovery trust address, and victims can check via a designated website; the attacker's laundering activity continues, but some funds have been intercepted by whitehats and entered a recovery process.
threads.latest_update_zh: 白帽黑客将52.37枚比特币从Coldcard黑客事件中转移至新成立的恢复信托地址；约40%的Wave 2资金被确认为白帽活动；受害者可在cryptorecoverytrust.com查询资金是否被追回；另有3.0134枚比特币无先前追踪记录流入该地址。
threads.latest_update_en: Whitehats moved 52.37 BTC from the Coldcard hack to a newly formed recovery trust; roughly 40% of Wave 2 funds identified as whitehat activity; victims can check cryptorecoverytrust.com to see if funds were recovered; an additional 3.0134 BTC with no prior tracking history flowed to the same address.
threads.background_zh: Coldcard 是一款流行的比特币硬件钱包。所谓“第三波”攻击指一系列针对钱包的盗窃事件，这些钱包的助记词显然是在熵不足或可预测的情况下生成的，因此攻击者即使未接触硬件也能推导出私钥。THORChain 是一个跨链流动性协议，CoinJoin 则是一种比特币隐私技术，通过混币来切断交易链条。Galaxy Research 一直在追踪这些链上资金流动，并呼吁受影响用户上报损失。
threads.background_en: Coldcard is a popular Bitcoin hardware wallet. The so-called 'Wave 3' attacks refer to a series of thefts from wallets whose seed phrases were apparently generated with insufficient or predictable entropy, so attackers could derive private keys despite the hardware being offline. THORChain is a cross-chain liquidity protocol, and CoinJoin is a Bitcoin privacy technique that mixes coins to break the transaction trail. Galaxy Research has been tracking these on-chain movements and asking affected users to report their losses.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Whitehats move 52 bitcoin from the Coldcard hack to a recovery trust
threads.latest_summary_en: Whitehats move 52 bitcoin from the Coldcard hack to a recovery trust
threads.discussion_zh: 被盗 BTC 经 THORChain 和 CoinJoin 转移，增加了部分资金最终流入交易所的可能性，可能影响比特币的流动性和市场情绪；同时，备受关注的 Coldcard 事件也可能削弱用户对硬件钱包产品的信心。这些转账本身不算直接市场交易，不应被视为价格方向性信号。
threads.discussion_en: Movement of stolen BTC through THORChain and CoinJoin raises the likelihood that some funds eventually reach exchanges, which could affect Bitcoin liquidity and sentiment; at the same time, high-profile Coldcard incidents may shake confidence in hardware-wallet products. The transfers themselves do not constitute a direct market trade and should not be read as a directional signal.

threads.title_zh: ZetaChain votes to shut down Layer 1 network and move ZETA to Solana
threads.title_en: ZetaChain votes to shut down Layer 1 network and move ZETA to Solana
threads.summary_zh: 第68号提案以99.4%支持和58%参与率通过；交易所须先确认置换，第二次投票才会确定快照、申领和关停时间表，因此关停与迁移仍未执行，验证者继续运行，质押奖励继续发放。
threads.summary_en: Proposal 68 passed with 99.4% support and 58% participation; exchanges must first confirm the swap before a second vote sets the snapshot, claims, and shutdown schedule, so shutdown and migration remain pending while validators continue operating and staking rewards continue.
threads.latest_update_zh: 交易所必须确认 ZETA 至 Solana 的置换后，第二次治理投票才会确定快照、代币申领和关停时间表。
threads.latest_update_en: Exchanges must confirm the ZETA-to-Solana swap before a second governance vote sets the snapshot, token claims, and shutdown schedule.
threads.background_zh: ZetaChain 基于 Cosmos SDK 和 Tendermint 共识构建，并包含一个兼容以太坊虚拟机的执行层 zEVM，定位为支持全链（omnichain）智能合约和跨链消息传递的基础层。Anuma 是同一团队的私密 AI 聊天产品，它会为用户对话建立加密记忆，数据保存在用户设备上并可跨不同 AI 模型使用。Solana 是一条高吞吐量的 Layer 1，SPL 是其原生代币标准，因此 ZETA 迁移意味着在 Solana 上发行该资产并在原链上将其退出。
threads.background_en: ZetaChain was built with the Cosmos SDK and Tendermint consensus and included an Ethereum Virtual Machine-compatible execution layer called zEVM, positioning itself as a base layer for omnichain smart contracts and cross-chain messaging between otherwise separate networks. Anuma is the same team's private AI chat product, which builds an encrypted memory of a user's conversations that stays on the user's device and travels across different AI models. Solana is a high-throughput Layer 1, and SPL is its native token standard, so migrating ZETA means issuing the asset on Solana and retiring it on its original chain.
threads.latest_summary_zh: 提案 68 以 99.4% 的支持率和 58% 的参与率通过，但交易所必须确认该置换后，第二次投票才会确定快照、申领和关停时间表。
threads.latest_summary_en: Proposal 68 passed with 99.4% support and 58% participation, but exchanges must confirm the swap before a second vote sets the snapshot, claims and shutdown schedule.
threads.discussion_zh: 该投票使 ZETA 资产进入链迁移通道，其原链将逐步退出，这会影响上线 ZETA 的交易所的现货流动性与兑换机制，并使验证者及跨链桥相关活动从 ZetaChain 生态中流出。若迁移顺利完成，Solana 生态的代币版图中将新增一枚 SPL 资产，而此次关停本身也会强化市场对小型 Layer 1 网络可持续性的讨论情绪。
threads.discussion_en: The vote puts the ZETA asset on a path toward a chain migration and the retirement of its original network, which affects spot liquidity and redemption mechanics on exchanges that list ZETA, and shifts validator and bridge-related activity away from the ZetaChain ecosystem. A successful migration would also add another Solana SPL asset to that ecosystem's token universe, while the wind-down itself feeds broader sentiment about the sustainability of smaller Layer 1 networks.
threads.market_impact_zh: 该投票使 ZETA 资产进入链迁移通道，其原链将逐步退出，这会影响上线 ZETA 的交易所的现货流动性与兑换机制，并使验证者及跨链桥相关活动从 ZetaChain 生态中流出。若迁移顺利完成，Solana 生态的代币版图中将新增一枚 SPL 资产，而此次关停本身也会强化市场对小型 Layer 1 网络可持续性的讨论情绪。
threads.market_impact_en: The vote puts the ZETA asset on a path toward a chain migration and the retirement of its original network, which affects spot liquidity and redemption mechanics on exchanges that list ZETA, and shifts validator and bridge-related activity away from the ZetaChain ecosystem. A successful migration would also add another Solana SPL asset to that ecosystem's token universe, while the wind-down itself feeds broader sentiment about the sustainability of smaller Layer 1 networks.

threads.title_en: ECB deploys Pontes platform to settle wholesale tokenized assets in central-bank money
threads.summary_zh: 欧元体系已推出 Pontes，为银行提供以中央银行货币结算代币化资产的实时通道；欧洲央行同时准备将自有资金投资于通过 Pontes 结算的代币化证券，全面实施目标为 2028 年。
threads.summary_en: The Eurosystem has launched Pontes, giving banks a live route to settle tokenized assets in central-bank money, while the ECB is preparing to invest its own funds in tokenized securities settling through Pontes, with full implementation targeted for 2028.
threads.latest_update_zh: 欧洲央行开始准备将一小部分自有资金投资于通过 Pontes 结算的代币化证券，并披露了首批参与机构及 2028 年全面实施目标。

threads.background_en: ECB deploys Pontes platform to settle wholesale tokenized assets in central-bank money

threads.latest_summary_en: The Eurosystem launched Pontes on Monday, giving banks a live route to settle tokenized assets in central-bank money, while the ECB began preparations to invest a small portion of its own funds in tokenized securities settling through Pontes. The ECB’s own-funds holdings were worth €23.1 billion at the end of 2025, with government debt at 73%, but it has not disclosed the size of the tokenized allocation or when purchases will begin.

threads.title_zh: Coinbase, Circle recover as SEC opens tokenized stock path - Yahoo Finance Australia
threads.title_en: Coinbase, Circle recover as SEC opens tokenized stock path - Yahoo Finance Australia
threads.summary_zh: SEC的代币化股票框架已进入分析师评估阶段，Coinbase、Robinhood和Circle被认定为潜在受益者，但需满足股东权利和AMM交易等条件。
threads.summary_en: The SEC's tokenized-stock framework is now being assessed by analysts, with Coinbase, Robinhood, and Circle identified as potential beneficiaries subject to conditions like shareholder rights and AMM-based trading.
threads.latest_update_zh: 分析师指出SEC的五年创新豁免可能使Coinbase、Robinhood和Circle受益，并详述了合规要求、交易上限和发行人退出等限制。
threads.latest_update_en: Analysts indicated the SEC's five-year innovation exemption could benefit Coinbase, Robinhood, and Circle, detailing compliance requirements, trading caps, and issuer opt-outs.
threads.background_zh: The SEC's move to open a regulatory path for tokenized stocks lifted shares of Coinbase and Circle, signaling potential mainstream adoption of blockchain-based equity trading.
threads.background_en: The SEC's move to open a regulatory path for tokenized stocks lifted shares of Coinbase and Circle, signaling potential mainstream adoption of blockchain-based equity trading.
threads.latest_summary_zh: 高盛和 Citizens 分析师表示，SEC 的五年创新豁免可能让符合条件的代币化美国股票通过公共区块链上的自动做市商交易，从而使 Coinbase、Robinhood 和 Circle 受益。但 Robinhood 需增加股东权利等特征以使股票代币合规，而交易上限、发行人退出和技术限制预计会保护传统交易所免受重大竞争。
threads.latest_summary_en: Goldman Sachs and Citizens analysts said the SEC's five-year innovation exemption could benefit Coinbase, Robinhood and Circle by allowing qualifying tokenized U.S. stocks to trade through automated market makers on public blockchains. They noted Robinhood must add shareholder rights and other features to make its stock tokens compliant, while trading caps, issuer opt-outs and technical limits are expected to protect traditional exchanges from significant competition.

threads.title_en: State hackers drive 420% surge in onchain malware, Chainalysis finds
threads.summary_zh: Chainalysis 报告链上恶意软件活动同比增长 420%，朝鲜和伊朗关联黑客约占新增活动的三分之二；新归因的朝鲜关联组织 UNC5342 使用 Tron、Aptos 和 BNB Smart Chain 作为冗余路径，伊朗关联行为者则利用比特币交易（包括向中本聪相关地址发送的交易）嵌入命令与控制路由信息。
threads.summary_en: Chainalysis reports a 420% year-over-year surge in onchain malware, with North Korea- and Iran-linked hackers responsible for roughly two-thirds of new activity; the newly attributed North Korea-linked UNC5342 group uses Tron, Aptos, and BNB Smart Chain as redundant routes, while Iran-linked actors embed command-and-control routing data in Bitcoin transactions, including those sent to a Satoshi Nakamoto-associated address.
threads.latest_update_zh: Chainalysis 报告补充了伊朗关联行为者将命令与控制路由信息嵌入发送至中本聪相关比特币地址的交易中，并指出高容量开源权重中国 AI 模型出现后恶意区块链写入从每天 2.06 次升至 11.1 次（增长 440%）。
threads.latest_update_en: Chainalysis report added that suspected Iran-linked actors embed command-and-control routing data inside Bitcoin transactions sent to a Satoshi Nakamoto-associated address, and that malicious blockchain writes rose from 2.06 to 11.1 per day (a 440% increase) after the emergence of high-capacity open-weight Chinese AI models.
threads.background_zh: 链上恶意软件指的是一种技术手法：攻击者把指令、服务器地址或载荷存放在公共区块链上，使被感染的设备无需依赖可被下线的域名即可获取这些内容。最知名的变体是 EtherHiding，朝鲜黑客曾在 2025 年利用它在以太坊和 BNB Smart Chain 的智能合约中植入窃取加密货币的代码。UNC5342 是一个与朝鲜相关的威胁组织，也被称为 Famous Chollima 和 DeceptiveDevelopment。Chainalysis 是一家区块链分析公司，为交易所、政府和金融机构追踪非法链上活动。
threads.background_en: Onchain malware refers to a technique in which attackers store instructions, server addresses or payloads on a public blockchain so that compromised devices can retrieve them without relying on a domain that can be taken offline. The best-known variant is EtherHiding, which North Korean hackers used in 2025 to place crypto-stealing code inside smart contracts on Ethereum and BNB Smart Chain. UNC5342 is a North Korea-linked threat group also tracked as Famous Chollima and DeceptiveDevelopment. Chainalysis is a blockchain analytics firm that tracks illicit onchain activity for exchanges, governments and financial institutions.
threads.latest_summary_zh:
Chainalysis 报告称，过去 12 个月内区块链“死信箱”（dead drop）攻击增长了 420%，到 2026 年第二季度，与朝鲜和伊朗有关联的操作者约占新观测活动总量的三分之二。与朝鲜有关联的团伙 UNC5342 使用 Tron 和 Aptos 作为冗余路径，将已感染设备引向存储在 BNB Smart Chain 上的恶意软件指令；而疑似伊朗行为者则把命令与控制路由信息嵌入发送至历史上与中本聪相关地址的比特币交易中。

这标志着攻击者的命令与控制手段从传统域名转向公共区块链基础设施，而传统执法下架手段难以将其关闭，意味着防御方必须同时在多条链上协调行动。对于加密交易所、钱包服务商以及企业而言，其合法流量与攻击者滥用的是同一批网络，安全与合规负担因此显著上升。

Chainalysis 表示，在高容量开源权重的中国 AI 模型出现后，恶意区块链写入从每天 2.06 次升至每天 11.1 次，不到一年增长 440%；不过该公司也提醒，其测量并不能锁定某一个具体模型，也无法证明增幅完全由 AI 造成。该恶意软件会优先查询 Tron，若该路径失败则回退至 Aptos，因此要瓦解该行动需要同时在三条链上采取行动。
threads.latest_summary_en:
Chainalysis reported that blockchain dead drop attacks rose 420% over the past 12 months, with North Korea- and Iran-linked operators accounting for roughly two-thirds of newly observed activity by the second quarter of 2026. The North Korea-linked group UNC5342 uses Tron and Aptos as redundant routes pointing infected devices to malware instructions stored on BNB Smart Chain, while suspected Iranian actors embedded command-and-control routing data inside Bitcoin transactions sent to an address historically associated with Satoshi Nakamoto.

This marks a shift from domain-based command-and-control to public blockchain infrastructure that conventional takedowns cannot easily disable, meaning defenders would have to coordinate action across multiple chains simultaneously. It raises the security and compliance burden for crypto exchanges, wallet providers and enterprises whose legitimate traffic shares the same networks that attackers are abusing.

Chainalysis said malicious blockchain writes rose from 2.06 per day to 11.1 per day after the emergence of high-capacity open-weight Chinese AI models, a 440% increase in under a year, though the firm cautioned its measurement does not identify a single model or prove that AI alone caused the rise. The malware queries Tron first and falls back to Aptos if that route fails, and disrupting the operation would require action across all three chains at once.
threads.discussion_zh: 这标志着攻击者的命令与控制手段从传统域名转向公共区块链基础设施，而传统执法下架手段难以将其关闭，意味着防御方必须同时在多条链上协调行动。对于加密交易所、钱包服务商以及企业而言，其合法流量与攻击者滥用的是同一批网络，安全与合规负担因此显著上升。
threads.discussion_en: This marks a shift from domain-based command-and-control to public blockchain infrastructure that conventional takedowns cannot easily disable, meaning defenders would have to coordinate action across multiple chains simultaneously. It raises the security and compliance burden for crypto exchanges, wallet providers and enterprises whose legitimate traffic shares the same networks that attackers are abusing.
threads.market_impact_zh: 其直接传导渠道是安全与合规，而非任何代币的供给：被点名承载恶意写入的网络是 Tron、BNB Smart Chain、Aptos 和比特币，因此这些链上的交易所、托管方和 RPC 服务商将面临更高的监控与筛查成本，因为对钱包、合约和 RPC 流量的监测正成为防御必需。由于彻底封锁某条网络也会切断同一基础设施上的合法钱包与 DeFi 服务，市场层面的影响更可能是链级风险溢价与合规开支持续上升，而非某一次可明确识别的价格事件。
threads.market_impact_en: The immediate channel is security and compliance rather than any token's supply: Tron, BNB Smart Chain, Aptos and Bitcoin are the networks actually named as carrying malicious writes, so exchanges, custodians and RPC providers on those chains face higher monitoring and screening costs as wallet, contract and RPC-traffic surveillance becomes a defensive necessity. Because fully blocking a network would also cut off legitimate wallets and DeFi services on the same infrastructure, the likely market effect is a gradual rise in chain-level risk premia and compliance overhead rather than a single identifiable price event.

threads.title_zh: Zcash targets November for NU7 mainnet upgrade with 25-second blocks
threads.title_en: Zcash targets November for NU7 mainnet upgrade with 25-second blocks
threads.summary_zh: Zcash 开发者一致同意在 11 月 5 日激活 NU7 主网升级，将出块时间从 75 秒缩短至 25 秒，同时通过 ZIP 218 保持每日发行量不变，并集成网络可持续机制（2026 年开始费用银行，2031 年 2 月发放补充奖励），减半计划保持不变。
threads.summary_en: Zcash developers unanimously agreed to activate the NU7 mainnet upgrade on Nov. 5, cutting block times from 75 to 25 seconds while keeping daily issuance unchanged via ZIP 218, and integrating the Network Sustainability Mechanism (fee banking starting 2026, supplemental rewards in Feb. 2031), with halvings preserved.
threads.latest_update_zh: 开发者透露 NU7 测试网将于 10 月 6 日上线，主网激活高度将于 10 月 20 日确定，规范于 9 月 30 日前发布；ZIP 218 将每块奖励除以约三倍以保持每日发行量不变；98.9% 的持币者投票支持保留减半机制；网络可持续机制将从 2026 年开始将约 60% 的交易费用存入，并于 2031 年 2 月开始作为补充挖矿奖励发放。
threads.latest_update_en: Developers revealed NU7 testnet on Oct. 6, mainnet activation height set on Oct. 20, specs due by Sept. 30; ZIP 218 divides per-block reward by ~3 to keep daily issuance unchanged; 98.9% of coinholders voted to keep halvings; Network Sustainability Mechanism will bank ~60% of transaction fees starting 2026, flowing back as supplemental mining rewards in Feb. 2031.
threads.background_zh: Zcash developers have reached unanimous agreement to target November 5 for the NU7 mainnet upgrade, which will cut block times to 25 seconds, disable version 4 transactions, and integrate the Network Sustainability Mechanism while preserving the halving schedule.
threads.background_en: Zcash developers have reached unanimous agreement to target November 5 for the NU7 mainnet upgrade, which will cut block times to 25 seconds, disable version 4 transactions, and integrate the Network Sustainability Mechanism while preserving the halving schedule.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Zcash developers plan to activate the NU7 upgrade on Nov. 5, tripling block speed from 75 to 25 seconds while keeping daily ZEC issuance unchanged and adding a 2026 fee-banking mechanism to fund miners after 2031.
threads.latest_summary_en: Zcash developers plan to activate the NU7 upgrade on Nov. 5, tripling block speed from 75 to 25 seconds while keeping daily ZEC issuance unchanged and adding a 2026 fee-banking mechanism to fund miners after 2031.

threads.title_zh: Coinbase (COIN) Stock Jumps 10% After Filing for US Single-Stock Perps - The Crypto Times
threads.title_en: Coinbase (COIN) Stock Jumps 10% After Filing for US Single-Stock Perps - The Crypto Times
threads.summary_zh: Coinbase Derivatives 已向 CFTC 提交个股永续合约申请，标的包括苹果、特斯拉、英伟达等；产品尚未获批或上线。此前 Coinbase 股价因该申请消息上涨 10%。
threads.summary_en: Coinbase Derivatives has filed with the CFTC for single-stock perpetual futures on Apple, Tesla, Nvidia, and others; products are not yet approved or live. Earlier, Coinbase stock jumped 10% on the filing news.
threads.latest_update_zh: Coinbase Derivatives 已向 CFTC 提交申请，拟上线苹果、特斯拉、英伟达等个股的现金结算永续合约，将境内永续合约布局从股指扩展至单一证券。产品尚未获批或上线。
threads.latest_update_en: Coinbase Derivatives has filed with the CFTC for cash-settled perpetual futures on individual stocks including Apple, Tesla, and Nvidia, extending its domestic perpetual futures push from equity indexes to single securities. Products are not yet approved or live.
threads.background_zh: 永续合约是一种没有到期日、追踪标的资产的衍生品，最早由经济学家罗伯特·席勒于 1992 年提出，后来在加密交易所中广泛流行；其功能与差价合约类似，但通过资金费率机制使价格贴近标的。在美国，期货市场由商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）监管，而 Coinbase Derivatives 正是受 CFTC 监管的交易所，因此上线新合约必须先提交申请。离岸平台多年来已提供股票挂钩的永续产品，但美国挂牌的个股永续合约此前并非标准的受监管产品。
threads.background_en: Perpetual futures are derivative contracts that track an underlying asset without an expiration date, first proposed by economist Robert Shiller in 1992 and later popularized by crypto exchanges; they function similarly to contracts for difference but use a funding-rate mechanism to keep the price anchored. In the U.S., futures markets are regulated by the CFTC, and Coinbase Derivatives operates as a CFTC-regulated exchange, which is why the company must file before listing new contracts. Offshore venues have offered equity-linked perpetuals for years, but U.S.-listed single-stock perpetuals have not been a standard regulated product.
threads.latest_summary_zh:
据《华尔街日报》报道，Coinbase Derivatives 已向美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）提交申请，拟上线与苹果、特斯拉、英伟达等美国上市个股及 ETF 挂钩的现金结算永续合约。此次申请将该交易所的境内永续合约布局从股票指数扩展到单一证券。

若获批，这将成为美国受监管平台上最早的一批个股永续合约产品之一，模糊加密原生衍生品与传统股票交易的边界。它表明头部加密交易所正在争夺股票挂钩的流量，可能重塑市场结构，并把新的机构与散户参与者吸引到 7×24 小时交易的场所。

拟议合约采用现金结算且为永续结构，即没有到期日，而是通过定期资金费率机制来锚定标的股价。该申请建立在 Coinbase 现有的衍生产品线之上——其平台已提供加密期货、Mag7+Crypto 指数产品以及 7×24 小时的比特币和以太坊期货交易——但相关个股产品目前尚未获批，也未正式上线。
threads.latest_summary_en:
Coinbase Derivatives has filed with the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) to list cash-settled perpetual futures tied to individual U.S.-listed stocks and ETFs, including Apple, Tesla and Nvidia, according to a Wall Street Journal report. The filing extends Coinbase's domestic perpetual-futures push from equity indexes to single securities.

If approved, this would mark one of the first U.S.-regulated venues offering perpetual futures on individual equities, blurring the line between crypto-native derivatives and traditional stock trading. It signals that major crypto exchanges are competing for equity-linked flow, which could reshape market structure and pull new institutional and retail participants onto 24/7 venues.

The proposed contracts are cash-settled and perpetual, meaning they carry no expiry date and instead rely on periodic funding payments to track the underlying stock price. The filing follows Coinbase's existing broad derivatives lineup, which already includes crypto futures, a Mag7+Crypto index product, and 24/7 bitcoin and ether futures trading, and the products are not yet approved or live.
threads.discussion_zh: 若获批，这将成为美国受监管平台上最早的一批个股永续合约产品之一，模糊加密原生衍生品与传统股票交易的边界。它表明头部加密交易所正在争夺股票挂钩的流量，可能重塑市场结构，并把新的机构与散户参与者吸引到 7×24 小时交易的场所。
threads.discussion_en: If approved, this would mark one of the first U.S.-regulated venues offering perpetual futures on individual equities, blurring the line between crypto-native derivatives and traditional stock trading. It signals that major crypto exchanges are competing for equity-linked flow, which could reshape market structure and pull new institutional and retail participants onto 24/7 venues.
threads.market_impact_zh: 该申请指向一条潜在通道：股票挂钩的需求可能被引导至加密原生、7×24 小时交易的场所，从而影响 Coinbase 的衍生品收入结构，并对已经融合股票与加密交易的币安、Crypto.com 等竞争者形成压力。若获批，它还将为在岸个股永续合约树立监管先例，可能改变流动性与对冲活动在传统交易所与加密平台之间的分布。
threads.market_impact_en: The filing points to a potential channel through which equity-linked demand could be routed onto crypto-native, 24/7 trading venues, exposing Coinbase's derivatives revenue mix and pressuring competitors such as Binance and Crypto.com that already blend stock and crypto trading. Approval would also set a regulatory precedent for onshore single-stock perpetuals, which could affect how liquidity and hedging activity are distributed between traditional exchanges and crypto platforms.

threads.title_zh: FCA Guidance Lands Two Weeks Before UK Crypto Authorization Window Opens
threads.title_en: FCA Guidance Lands Two Weeks Before UK Crypto Authorization Window Opens
threads.summary_zh: 英国 FCA 已发布最终加密授权 perimeter 指引，其中包括海外平台/托管/质押服务何时需要英国授权的属地边界规则；申请窗口于 2026 年 9 月 30 日开放，过渡申请截止日为 2027 年 2 月 28 日，新制度于 2027 年 10 月 25 日生效，现有注册/许可不会自动转换。
threads.summary_en: The UK FCA has published final crypto authorization perimeter guidance, including territorial boundary rules for when offshore platform, custody, and staking services require UK authorization; the application window opens Sept. 30, 2026, transitional applications close Feb. 28, 2027, the new regime takes effect Oct. 25, 2027, and existing registrations/permissions do not automatically convert.
threads.latest_update_zh: 新增了FCA最终 perimeter 指引中针对海外加密平台的属地边界规则：为英国消费者服务的海外平台、托管和质押服务可能被纳入授权范围，并解释了‘英国消费者’定义、第418条视为条款及代理/自营交易等具体条件。
threads.latest_update_en: Added territorial boundary rules from the FCA's final perimeter guidance for offshore crypto platforms: overseas platforms, custody, and staking providers serving UK consumers may fall within the authorization perimeter, with details on the 'UK consumer' definition, Section 418 deeming provisions, and agent/principal trading conditions.
threads.background_zh: 英国正在建立一套专门的监管制度，依据《金融服务与市场法》（FSMA）将加密资产纳入FCA的监管范围，而不再仅让公司停留在现有的反洗钱注册框架之下。英国议会已于2月批准相关授权立法，FCA在6月敲定了一揽子规则与指引，并计划在2027年前分阶段过渡。“合格稳定币”指的是试图通过锚定法定货币（如英镑或美元）来维持价值的加密资产。此外，英国上议院以194票对138票通过了一项对《金融服务与市场法》法案的修正案，要求财政部在该法案生效后12个月内制定一项涵盖加密资产、稳定币、代币化证券和数字金融基础设施的数字资产战略。
threads.background_en: The UK is building a dedicated regulatory regime that brings cryptoassets into the FCA's remit under the Financial Services and Markets Act (FSMA), rather than leaving firms under the existing anti-money-laundering registration framework. Parliament approved the enabling regulations in February and the FCA finalized a package of rules and guidance in June, with a phased transition planned through 2027. "Qualifying stablecoins" refers to cryptoassets that seek to maintain their value by reference to a fiat currency, such as sterling or the US dollar. Separately, the House of Lords voted 194–138 to amend the Financial Services and Markets Bill to require the Treasury to produce a digital asset strategy within 12 months of the bill becoming law.
threads.latest_summary_zh: The FCA published final guidance clarifying when overseas crypto platforms, custody, and staking providers must obtain UK authorization, with applications opening Sept. 30, 2026 and rules effective Oct. 25, 2027.
threads.latest_summary_en: The FCA published final guidance clarifying when overseas crypto platforms, custody, and staking providers must obtain UK authorization, with applications opening Sept. 30, 2026 and rules effective Oct. 25, 2027.
threads.discussion_zh: 该指引将影响所有涉及英国零售业务的交易场所和服务提供商的市场结构——包括交易平台、交易商、托管方和质押服务安排方——因为获得授权成为继续进入英国市场的前提，而缺乏海外主体豁免使得非英国公司也被纳入监管范围。合规成本与牌照风险是主要的传导渠道，并会对英镑计价稳定币的发行以及FCA另行审查的代币化资产产品产生连带影响。
threads.discussion_en: The guidance affects market structure for any venue or service provider with UK retail exposure — trading platforms, dealers, custodians and staking arrangers — since authorization becomes a precondition for continued market access, and the absence of an overseas persons exclusion pulls non-UK firms into scope. Compliance cost and licensing risk are the main transmission channels, with knock-on implications for GBP-denominated stablecoin issuance and for tokenized asset products the FCA is reviewing separately.

threads.summary_zh: CFTC 的加密资产市场规则制定已提交白宫 OIRA，编号 RIN 3038-AF80，处于 pre-rule（预规则）阶段，尚未成为拟议规则；提交时间为9月17日，即参议院阻止 CLARITY Act 两天后。

threads.title_zh: SEC Opens Door To Tokenized Stocks With New ‘Innovation Exemption’ - TradingView
threads.title_en: SEC Opens Door To Tokenized Stocks With New ‘Innovation Exemption’ - TradingView
threads.summary_zh: SEC 已批准创新豁免，允许符合条件的场所在公共区块链上交易代币化美国股票而无需注册为国家交易所，该豁免立即生效、为期五年，包含发行人30天异议权，且仅适用于具有完整权利的真正代币化股票。
threads.summary_en: The SEC has approved the Innovation Exemption, enabling qualifying venues to trade tokenized US stocks on public blockchains without national exchange registration, effective immediately for five years, with an issuer 30-day objection right and limited to real tokenized stocks carrying full rights.
threads.latest_update_zh: SEC 批准了‘创新豁免’，立即生效，为期五年，允许符合条件的代币化证券交易场所无需注册为国家交易所即可在公共区块链上交易代币化美国股票；发行人有30天时间反对未经关联方对其股票进行代币化。
threads.latest_update_en: The SEC approved the 'Innovation Exemption,' effective immediately for five years, allowing qualifying Tokenized Securities Venues to trade tokenized US stocks on public blockchains without registering as national exchanges; issuers have 30 days to object to unaffiliated tokenization of their shares.
threads.background_zh: 代币化指的是把某项资产（例如一只美国上市公司股票）以区块链数字凭证的形式发行，从而可以在链上交易和结算。SEC 这次处理的并不是“股票该不该变成代币”这一宽泛问题，而是已被监管的证券如何通过区块链基础设施交易、同时交易场所不被认定为未注册交易所这一更窄的问题。按照现行规定，受监管的美国股票必须在依《证券交易法》注册的交易所交易，这也是加密公司此前主要面向非美国用户提供代币化股票的原因，例如 Kraken 面向欧洲客户的 xStocks 平台。CLARITY 法案原本旨在为数字资产确立成文法规则、厘清各监管机构的职责，其推进失败使得政策重心转向监管机构在现行法律下能做什么。自动做市商则是通过智能合约资金池以算法方式定价、而非依赖传统订单簿的机制。
threads.background_en: Tokenization means issuing a blockchain-based digital representation of an asset, such as a US-listed share, so it can be traded and settled on-chain; the question the SEC addressed is narrower than "should stocks be tokens" and concerns how already-regulated securities can trade through blockchain infrastructure without the venue being treated as an unregistered exchange. Currently, trading of a regulated US stock must occur on a registered exchange under the Securities Exchange Act, which is why crypto firms have offered tokenized equities primarily to non-US users — for example, Kraken's xStocks platform for European customers. The CLARITY Act was the market-structure bill meant to establish statutory rules for digital assets and clarify which agency regulates what; its failure pushed the emphasis onto what regulators can do under existing law. Automated market makers are smart-contract pools that price trades algorithmically instead of through a traditional order book.
threads.latest_summary_zh: The SEC approved an 'Innovation Exemption' permitting qualifying venues to trade tokenized US stocks on public blockchains without registering as national exchanges, while the CFTC issued a no-action letter easing broker rules, driving a broad altcoin rally.
threads.latest_summary_en: The SEC approved an 'Innovation Exemption' permitting qualifying venues to trade tokenized US stocks on public blockchains without registering as national exchanges, while the CFTC issued a no-action letter easing broker rules, driving a broad altcoin rally.
threads.discussion_zh: 最直接的传导渠道是情绪与流动性流入与链上交易场所和 DeFi 基础设施相关的代币，HYPE、UNI、ARB 和 NEAR 领涨，同时 BTC 报78,000美元、ETH 报2,500美元。若代币化股票未来能在无许可链上通过自动做市商和流动性池运行，资金与订单流将逐步向 DEX 代币、托管服务商以及与交易所关联的标的倾斜；而 ICE 评估将 Avalanche 作为结算层，则把传统股票市场基础设施直接与一层网络资产连接起来。
threads.discussion_en: The immediate transmission channel is sentiment and liquidity into tokens tied to onchain trading venues and DeFi infrastructure, with HYPE, UNI, ARB and NEAR leading the rally alongside BTC at $78k and ETH at $2,500. Over time, enabling tokenized equities to run through automated market makers and liquidity pools on permissionless chains would pull capital and order flow toward DEX tokens, custody providers, and exchange-linked names, while the ICE evaluation of Avalanche as a settlement layer connects legacy equity-market infrastructure directly to layer-1 assets.

threads.title_zh: SEC and CFTC bypass Congress to open crypto access after CLARITY fails  – with a catch
threads.title_en: SEC and CFTC bypass Congress to open crypto access after CLARITY fails  – with a catch
threads.summary_zh: 在参议院未能推进CLARITY法案后，SEC为合格平台提供了五年期条件性豁免以进行特定代币化股票交易，CFTC扩大了针对被动软件提供商的无行动救济，并且CFTC现已向OMB提交加密市场规则提案等待审查，之后还需CFTC投票和公开征求意见才能生效。
threads.summary_en: After the Senate failed to advance the CLARITY Act, the SEC created a five-year conditional exemption for qualifying platforms to trade certain tokenized stocks, the CFTC broadened no-action relief for passive software providers, and the CFTC has now submitted a crypto market rules proposal to OMB for review, with a CFTC vote and public comment still needed before it can take effect.
threads.latest_update_zh: CFTC于周四向白宫管理和预算办公室（OMB）提交了一份新的加密市场规则提案，该提案在OMB审查后将返回CFTC进行投票和公开征求意见。
threads.latest_update_en: The CFTC submitted a new crypto market rules proposal to the White House Office of Management and Budget (OMB) on Thursday; after OMB review, it will return to the CFTC for a vote and public comment.
threads.background_zh: After the Senate failed to advance the CLARITY Act, the SEC created a five-year conditional path for permissioned venues to trade tokenized US stocks via automated market makers, while the CFTC broadened no-action relief for software providers connecting users to regulated derivatives markets.
threads.background_en: After the Senate failed to advance the CLARITY Act, the SEC created a five-year conditional path for permissioned venues to trade tokenized US stocks via automated market makers, while the CFTC broadened no-action relief for software providers connecting users to regulated derivatives markets.
threads.latest_summary_zh: The CFTC sent a crypto market proposal to the White House for review after the CLARITY Act failed in the Senate, while the SEC introduced a five-year conditional exemption for qualifying tokenized-stock platforms and the CFTC issued no-action relief for certain passive software providers.
threads.latest_summary_en: The CFTC sent a crypto market proposal to the White House for review after the CLARITY Act failed in the Senate, while the SEC introduced a five-year conditional exemption for qualifying tokenized-stock platforms and the CFTC issued no-action relief for certain passive software providers.

threads.title_zh: Binance MiCA Application Faces ECB Concerns in Greece - The Cryptonomist
threads.title_en: Binance MiCA Application Faces ECB Concerns in Greece - The Cryptonomist
threads.summary_zh: 币安在希腊的MiCA申请在据报欧洲央行行长拉加德高层干预后陷入停滞，尽管此前监管机构认为申请已完整。
threads.summary_en: Binance's MiCA application in Greece is stalled following reported high-level ECB intervention by President Lagarde, despite prior regulatory completeness.
threads.latest_update_zh: 欧洲央行行长克里斯蒂娜·拉加德亲自干预阻止币安欧盟MiCA牌照，导致希腊搁置此前监管机构认为已完成的申请，据《华尔街日报》。
threads.latest_update_en: ECB President Christine Lagarde personally intervened to block Binance's EU MiCA license, leading Greece to stall an application regulators had previously deemed complete, according to the WSJ.
threads.background_zh: MiCA（《加密资产市场法规》）是欧盟针对加密资产及其服务提供商的综合性监管规则：企业须在某一成员国取得该国主管机构颁发的牌照，之后即可凭该牌照在整个欧盟范围内通行。MiCA 的完整要求已于 2024 年底生效，过渡性的“祖父条款”宽限期于 2025 年 7 月 1 日到期，此后未持牌企业必须停止向欧盟客户提供服务。欧洲央行并非一般意义上的加密资产监管机构，其介入源于货币政策职责、对数字欧元项目的监管角色以及对加密资产金融稳定风险的监测，因此报道所述的干预显得非同寻常。
threads.background_en: MiCA (Markets in Crypto-Assets) is the EU's comprehensive rulebook for crypto assets and service providers; firms must be licensed by a national competent authority in one member state, and that license can then be passported across the entire bloc. Full MiCA requirements took effect at the end of 2024, with a transitional grandfathering period that expired on 1 July 2025, after which unlicensed firms must stop serving EU customers. The ECB is not a general crypto regulator — its involvement stems from its monetary policy mandate, its oversight of the digital euro project, and its monitoring of financial stability risks from crypto — which is why the reported intervention is unusual.
threads.latest_summary_zh: ECB President Christine Lagarde intervened to block Binance's EU MiCA license, leading Greece to stall an application regulators had previously deemed complete, according to the WSJ.
threads.latest_summary_en: ECB President Christine Lagarde intervened to block Binance's EU MiCA license, leading Greece to stall an application regulators had previously deemed complete, according to the WSJ.
threads.discussion_zh: 最直接的传导渠道是市场准入与流动性：在币安无法凭 MiCA 牌照通行的情况下，欧盟居民用户以及欧元计价的现货与衍生品交易流量将转向已获牌的交易所，使原本集中于币安的流动性出现分割，并改变欧盟受监管交易所之间的交易量份额。第二个渠道是监管先例：报道所称欧洲央行对成员国监管机构施加非正式压力的做法，会提高其他有申请在途的大型交易所所面临的牌照风险溢价，并可能影响交易所在欧盟的实体架构与托管安排。
threads.discussion_en: The immediate channel is market access and liquidity: with Binance unable to passport a MiCA license, EU-resident users and euro-denominated spot and derivatives flow toward already-licensed venues, fragmenting liquidity that previously concentrated on Binance and shifting volume share among EU-regulated exchanges. A second channel is regulatory precedent — the reported use of informal ECB pressure on a national regulator raises licensing risk premiums for other large exchanges with pending applications and could influence how venues structure their EU entities and custody arrangements.

threads.title_zh: US sanctions Iranian crypto exchange BitBank over alleged bitcoin transfers to IRGC
threads.title_en: US sanctions Iranian crypto exchange BitBank over alleged bitcoin transfers to IRGC
threads.summary_zh: 美国财政部已制裁伊朗加密交易所BitBank，并进一步制裁与BitBank相关的Pishtaz Simorgh Electronic Trade Company及三名Dot One高管；制裁依据第13902号行政令，属于“经济弃儿行动”的一部分。
threads.summary_en: The U.S. Treasury has sanctioned Iranian crypto exchange BitBank and further designated BitBank-related Pishtaz Simorgh Electronic Trade Company and three Dot One executives under Executive Order 13902 as part of Operation Economic Outcast.
threads.latest_update_zh: OFAC还指定了与BitBank相关的另外五名个人和实体，并披露BitBank由Babak Zanjani控制，在6月至7月间转移了数亿美元比特币给IRGC，且Hormuz Safe自6月以来通过BitBank处理通行费支付。
threads.latest_update_en: OFAC also designated five additional individuals and entities tied to BitBank, and disclosed that BitBank is controlled by Babak Zanjani, moved hundreds of millions in Bitcoin to the IRGC between June and July, and that Hormuz Safe has routed toll payments through BitBank since June.
threads.background_zh: The U.S. Treasury sanctioned Iranian crypto exchange BitBank for allegedly processing bitcoin payments collected by the previously sanctioned Hormuz Safe platform on behalf of the IRGC.
threads.background_en: The U.S. Treasury sanctioned Iranian crypto exchange BitBank for allegedly processing bitcoin payments collected by the previously sanctioned Hormuz Safe platform on behalf of the IRGC.
threads.latest_summary_zh: The U.S. Treasury's OFAC sanctioned BitBank, an Iranian exchange controlled by Babak Zanjani, for allegedly moving hundreds of millions in Bitcoin to the IRGC and processing Hormuz toll payments collected in Bitcoin from shipping companies.
threads.latest_summary_en: The U.S. Treasury's OFAC sanctioned BitBank, an Iranian exchange controlled by Babak Zanjani, for allegedly moving hundreds of millions in Bitcoin to the IRGC and processing Hormuz toll payments collected in Bitcoin from shipping companies.

threads.title_zh: US House crypto tax package omits mining, staking reward deferral
threads.title_en: US House crypto tax package omits mining, staking reward deferral
threads.summary_zh: 《数字资产税收确定性法案》（H.R. 10357）已获众议院筹款委员会以38-5批准并采纳替代案，正向众议院全体会议推进；法案仍包括10美元合格费用豁免及稳定币、借贷、质押和挖矿条款，但未满足行业扩大日常支付豁免和递延/调整质押与挖矿奖励纳税时点的要求。
threads.summary_en: The Digital Asset Tax Certainty Act (H.R. 10357) has been approved by the House Ways and Means Committee 38-5 with a substitute adopted, advancing to the full House; the bill still includes a $10 qualifying-fee exception and provisions covering stablecoins, lending, staking and mining, but does not satisfy industry requests for broader de minimis relief and deferral or timing changes for staking and mining reward taxation.
threads.latest_update_zh: 众议院筹款委员会于9月16日以38票对5票批准了H.R. 10357《数字资产税收确定性法案》，并采纳了主席杰森·史密斯的替代案，将该法案推进至众议院全体会议；行业团体继续寻求扩大日常支付豁免并调整质押和挖矿奖励的纳税时点。
threads.latest_update_en: The House Ways and Means Committee approved H.R. 10357, the Digital Asset Tax Certainty Act, by 38-5 on Sept. 16, adopting Chairman Jason Smith’s substitute and sending the bill to the full House; industry groups continue to seek broader everyday-payment relief and changes to when staking and mining rewards become taxable.
threads.background_zh: The US House Ways and Means Committee's 114-page crypto tax package would overhaul tax treatment of crypto fees, stablecoins, and lending but omits a provision to defer taxation of mining and staking rewards until sale.
threads.background_en: The US House Ways and Means Committee's 114-page crypto tax package would overhaul tax treatment of crypto fees, stablecoins, and lending but omits a provision to defer taxation of mining and staking rewards until sale.
threads.latest_summary_zh: The House Ways and Means Committee approved H.R. 10357, the Digital Asset Tax Certainty Act, by 38-5, advancing the broadest federal crypto tax framework while industry groups push for broader relief on staking, mining, and everyday payments.
threads.latest_summary_en: The House Ways and Means Committee approved H.R. 10357, the Digital Asset Tax Certainty Act, by 38-5, advancing the broadest federal crypto tax framework while industry groups push for broader relief on staking, mining, and everyday payments.

threads.title_zh: Industry First: TradFi Perp Options, a new way to trade Stock Perpetuals.
threads.title_en: Industry First: TradFi Perp Options, a new way to trade Stock Perpetuals.
threads.summary_zh: Bybit 的 TradFi 股票永续期权（NVIDIA、SpaceX/SPCX）已正式上线，支持 24/7 交易、碎股、USDT 结算及统一交易账户组合保证金，后续将增加更多标的。
threads.summary_en: Bybit's TradFi stock perpetual options (NVIDIA, SpaceX/SPCX) are now live with 24/7 trading, fractional lots, USDT settlement, and Unified Trading Account portfolio margin; more tickers are planned.
threads.latest_update_zh: Bybit 已于 2026 年 9 月 17 日正式上线 NVIDIA 和 SpaceX 的永续期权，支持 24/7 交易、碎股、统一交易账户组合保证金及完整策略支持。
threads.latest_update_en: Bybit officially launched perpetual options on NVIDIA and SpaceX on September 17, 2026, with 24/7 trading, fractional lots, Unified Trading Account portfolio margin, and full strategy support.
threads.background_zh: 传统的场内期权都带有到期日，而到期日是期权定价与对冲的核心。永续期权则完全取消了到期日（因此也被称为“无到期日期权”），通常依靠类似资金费的机制把合约价格锚定在标的之上——这是加密衍生品交易所在永续合约兴起后普及开来的做法。Bybit 的统一交易账户让用户可以在同一个账户内、以共享保证金交易现货、杠杆、USDT/USDC 永续合约与期权，正是这一结构使多产品期权策略在此成为可行。英伟达是一家公开上市的 AI 芯片公司，而 SpaceX 是一家未上市的私营火箭与卫星公司，两者在参考价格的可得性上存在根本差异。
threads.background_en: Standard listed options carry an expiry date, which is central to how they are priced and hedged. Perpetual options remove that expiry entirely — they are sometimes called expirationless options — and typically rely on a funding-style mechanism to keep the contract price anchored to the underlying, an approach crypto derivatives venues popularized after perpetual futures took off. Bybit's Unified Trading Account lets a user trade spot, margin, USDT/USDC perpetuals and options from a single account with shared collateral, which is what makes a multi-product options strategy feasible here. NVIDIA is a publicly listed AI chipmaker, whereas SpaceX is a privately held rocket and satellite company with no public shares, so the two underlyings differ fundamentally in how a reference price can be observed.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Bybit has launched perpetual options on NVIDIA and SpaceX with 24/7 trading, fractional lots, and portfolio margin support via its Unified Trading Account.
threads.latest_summary_en: Bybit has launched perpetual options on NVIDIA and SpaceX with 24/7 trading, fractional lots, and portfolio margin support via its Unified Trading Account.
threads.discussion_zh: 其传导渠道是产品与市场结构，而非协议机制：通过提供对标股票与私营公司的 7×24 小时杠杆期权，Bybit 把传统市场休市时段的流动性与成交量引向加密交易场所，并与代币化股票及其他合成敞口类产品形成竞争。受到影响的市场环节包括离岸衍生品交易所、其保证金与抵押品体系，以及希望在股票市场交易时段之外对 AI 与航天主题敞口进行对冲的交易者。
threads.discussion_en: The transmission channel is product and market structure rather than protocol mechanics: by offering 24/7 leveraged options on equity and private-company names, Bybit shifts liquidity and trading volume toward crypto venues during hours when traditional markets are closed, and competes with tokenized-equity and other synthetic exposure products. The affected segments are offshore derivatives exchanges, their margin and collateral systems, and traders seeking hedges on AI- and space-themed exposure outside of equity market hours.

threads.summary_zh: 韩国警方正在调查26名Polymarket用户涉嫌非法赌博，其中18人已被移送检方，涉案下注总额约1270万美元，案件仍在进行中。
threads.summary_en: South Korean police are investigating 26 Polymarket users for illegal gambling; 18 have been referred to prosecutors, with total wagers of about $12.7 million, and the case remains ongoing.
threads.latest_update_zh: 韩国警方已将26名Polymarket用户中的18人移送检方，案件涉及非法赌博调查；这些用户合计下注约1270万美元，单人最高下注约410万美元。
threads.latest_update_en: South Korean police referred 18 of 26 Polymarket users to prosecutors in the illegal gambling probe; the users collectively wagered about $12.7 million, with the largest single user wagering about $4.1 million.
threads.background_zh: South Korean police have charged 26 Polymarket users with illegal gambling after the country's media regulator blocked local access to the prediction market platform.
threads.background_en: South Korean police have charged 26 Polymarket users with illegal gambling after the country's media regulator blocked local access to the prediction market platform.
threads.latest_summary_zh: South Korean police referred 18 Polymarket users to prosecutors in an illegal gambling probe involving 26 people who collectively wagered about $12.7 million.
threads.latest_summary_en: South Korean police referred 18 Polymarket users to prosecutors in an illegal gambling probe involving 26 people who collectively wagered about $12.7 million.

threads.title_zh: S&P Global to acquire blockchain security platform OpenZeppelin
threads.title_en: S&P Global to acquire blockchain security platform OpenZeppelin
threads.summary_zh: S&P Global 已同意收购 OpenZeppelin；OpenZeppelin 将作为独立业务部门运营，Demian Brener 留任 CEO 并向 Yann Le Pallec 汇报，交易财务条款未披露。
threads.summary_en: S&P Global has agreed to acquire OpenZeppelin; OpenZeppelin will operate as a separate business unit, with Demian Brener remaining CEO and reporting to Yann Le Pallec, and financial terms were not disclosed.
threads.latest_update_zh: 收购后 OpenZeppelin 将作为 S&P Global 旗下独立业务部门继续运营，联合创始人兼 CEO Demian Brener 留任并直接向 S&P Global Ratings 总裁 Yann Le Pallec 汇报；交易财务条款未披露。
threads.latest_update_en: After the acquisition, OpenZeppelin will continue operating as a separate S&P Global business unit, with co-founder and CEO Demian Brener remaining in charge and reporting to S&P Global Ratings President Yann Le Pallec; financial terms were not disclosed.
threads.background_zh: 智能合约是部署在以太坊、Solana、Cardano等区块链上的程序，当预设条件满足时会自动执行交易；由于其部署后通常不可更改，代码缺陷可能导致不可逆的损失。OpenZeppelin发布了使用最广泛的开源智能合约库，并提供安全审计服务，自2017年以来已完成900多次审计。其合约库、合约向导以及Ethernaut等安全教育工具，已成为构建代币化资产和DeFi协议开发者的实际标准。
threads.background_en: Smart contracts are programs on blockchains such as Ethereum, Solana, and Cardano that automatically execute transactions when preset conditions are met; once deployed they are often immutable, so a coding flaw can lead to irreversible losses. OpenZeppelin publishes the most widely used open-source smart contract libraries and also performs security audits, having completed more than 900 audits since 2017. Its libraries, contract wizard, and educational tools such as Ethernaut are a de facto standard for developers building tokenized assets and DeFi protocols.
threads.latest_summary_zh: S&P Global has agreed to acquire smart contract security firm OpenZeppelin to expand its risk assessment capabilities into the code underpinning tokenized financial products.
threads.latest_summary_en: S&P Global has agreed to acquire smart contract security firm OpenZeppelin to expand its risk assessment capabilities into the code underpinning tokenized financial products.
threads.discussion_zh: 这笔交易将传统金融的信誉与风险评估基础设施引入链上代码，可能提升机构配置代币化货币市场基金、代币化存款和稳定币结算通道的信心，从而利好这些细分赛道的需求，而非某一特定代币。它还强化了主流评级与数据服务商同使用OpenZeppelin库的DeFi协议之间的联系，使安全状况成为机构参与和代币化主题情绪中更为显性的变量。
threads.discussion_en: The deal channels traditional financial credibility and risk-assessment infrastructure into onchain code, which could raise the comfort level of institutions allocating to tokenized money market funds, tokenized deposits, and stablecoin rails, supporting demand for those segments rather than for any single token. It also tightens the link between mainstream ratings and data providers and the DeFi protocols using OpenZeppelin's libraries, making security posture a more visible input for institutional participation and sentiment around tokenization themes.

threads.market_impact_en: The deal channels traditional financial credibility and risk-assessment infrastructure into onchain code, which could raise the comfort level of institutions allocating to tokenized money market funds, tokenized deposits, and stablecoin rails, supporting demand for those segments rather than for any single token. It also tightens the link between mainstream ratings and data providers and the DeFi protocols using OpenZeppelin's libraries, making security posture a more visible input for institutional participation and sentiment around tokenization themes.

threads.title_zh: Revolut hackers demand $3 million in Monero, threaten to sell customer data
threads.title_en: Revolut hackers demand $3 million in Monero, threaten to sell customer data
threads.summary_zh: 名为“iamnotavillain”的团体要求 Revolut 在24小时内支付 6,000 XMR（约300万美元），否则将出售至少680个账户的客户身份文件和交易记录；Revolut 回应称未收到直接联系或勒索要求，受影响客户数量有限，资金和系统未受影响，报道称数据源自被入侵的意大利政府邮件系统且攻击者事前通过链上分析筛选了高净值客户。
threads.summary_en: A group calling itself 'iamnotavillain' has given Revolut 24 hours to pay 6,000 XMR (~$3 million) or it will sell customer identity documents and transaction records from at least 680 accounts; Revolut responded that it has received no direct contact or demand, called the number of affected customers 'limited,' said funds and systems were untouched, and the report says the data came via a compromised Italian government email system after attackers used blockchain analysis to target high-net-worth users.
threads.latest_update_zh: Revolut 表示未收到该团体任何直接联系或勒索要求，并称受影响客户数量“有限”、资金和系统未受影响；报道补充称数据通过入侵意大利政府邮件系统、以真实域名和有效认证伪装的信息请求在数月内获取，攻击者先用链上分析筛选高净值用户，并已向 FT 展示文件录屏。
threads.latest_update_en: Revolut said it has not received any direct contact or demand from the group, called the number of affected customers 'limited,' and said funds and systems were untouched; the report adds that data was obtained via a compromised Italian government email system using genuine domains and valid authentication over months, with attackers using blockchain analysis to target high-net-worth users and showing the FT a screen recording of files.
threads.background_zh: 门罗币是 2014 年推出的隐私型加密货币，其设计目标是隐藏交易细节、使资金流向难以追踪，这一特性使其成为勒索软件与敲诈勒索中常见的付款方式。Revolut 是一家总部位于英国的数字银行应用，全球超过 8000 万客户使用其多币种账户、跨境汇款和加密交易服务。根据 KYC（了解你的客户）规则，受监管金融机构必须收集身份文件和验证照片，这意味着一次成功的社工请求就可能泄露高度敏感的个人记录。
threads.background_en: Monero is a privacy-focused cryptocurrency launched in 2014 that is designed to obscure transaction details, making it difficult to trace payments — a property that has made it a common choice in ransomware and extortion demands. Revolut is a UK-headquartered digital banking app used by more than 80 million customers globally for multi-currency accounts, remittances and crypto trading. Under know-your-customer (KYC) rules, regulated financial firms must collect identity documents and verification photos, which means a single successful social-engineering request can expose highly sensitive personal records.
threads.latest_summary_zh: A group calling itself iamnotavillain has given Revolut 24 hours to pay 6,000 XMR (~$3M) or it will sell hundreds of customers' identity documents and transaction records, while Revolut says it has received no direct contact or demand.
threads.latest_summary_en: A group calling itself iamnotavillain has given Revolut 24 hours to pay 6,000 XMR (~$3M) or it will sell hundreds of customers' identity documents and transaction records, while Revolut says it has received no direct contact or demand.
threads.discussion_zh: 该事件让 XMR 作为被索要的付款资产受到关注，把隐私币叙事与一宗正在进行的敲诈案件联系在一起；而攻击者按加密持仓筛选账户的做法，也让保管用户 KYC 记录的交易所和金融科技平台面临数据安全层面的担忧。任何市场反应更可能通过隐私币情绪以及市场对加密相关金融科技公司保管个人数据的信任度传导，而非通过直接的供给或流动性变化。
threads.discussion_en: The incident puts XMR in the spotlight as the demanded payment asset, tying a privacy-coin narrative to an active extortion case, while the targeting of accounts by crypto holdings raises data-security concerns for exchanges and fintech platforms that custody user KYC records. Any market reaction would likely flow through sentiment around privacy coins and trust in crypto-adjacent fintech custody of personal data rather than through direct supply or liquidity changes.

threads.title_zh: Crypto Industry Points to SEC and CFTC After CLARITY Setback
threads.title_en: Crypto Industry Points to SEC and CFTC After CLARITY Setback
threads.summary_zh: 在《CLARITY 法案》于参议院受阻后，SEC 已通过为期五年的“创新豁免”允许代币化 NMS 股票在许可型自动做市商上交易；同时 CFTC 工作人员将 Introducing Broker 豁免扩大至被动软件。
threads.summary_en: After the CLARITY Act stalled in the Senate, the SEC has granted a five-year 'Innovation Exemption' allowing tokenized NMS stocks to trade on permissioned automated market makers, while CFTC staff extended introducing-broker relief to passive software.
threads.latest_update_zh: CFTC 工作人员将 Introducing Broker 豁免扩大至被动软件，同时 SEC 的五年期代币化美股豁免明确适用于许可型自动做市商（而非无需许可区块链）。
threads.latest_update_en: CFTC staff extended introducing-broker relief to passive software, and the SEC's five-year tokenized U.S. stock exemption was specified as applying to permissioned automated market makers (rather than permissionless blockchains).
threads.background_zh: After the Senate blocked the CLARITY Act, crypto trade groups and executives are urging the SEC and CFTC to advance crypto regulation through agency rulemaking, noting that rules are less durable than legislation since future chairs can rewrite them.
threads.background_en: After the Senate blocked the CLARITY Act, crypto trade groups and executives are urging the SEC and CFTC to advance crypto regulation through agency rulemaking, noting that rules are less durable than legislation since future chairs can rewrite them.
threads.latest_summary_zh: The SEC granted a five-year conditional exemption allowing tokenized National Market System stocks to trade on permissioned automated market makers, while CFTC staff extended introducing-broker relief to passive software.
threads.latest_summary_en: The SEC granted a five-year conditional exemption allowing tokenized National Market System stocks to trade on permissioned automated market makers, while CFTC staff extended introducing-broker relief to passive software.

threads.title_zh: Celsius sues BitMEX for $495 million just 11 days before exchange shutdown
threads.title_en: Celsius sues BitMEX for $495 million just 11 days before exchange shutdown
threads.summary_zh: Celsius 破产财产于9月12日在美国纽约南区破产法院对五家 BitMEX 实体提起诉讼，就 2020 年3月崩盘期间被清算的 BTC 索赔；最新报道补充了 XBTM20 杠杆衍生品交易细节及 Mashinsky 否认交易的公开表态。BitMEX 将于9月23日停止交易。
threads.summary_en: Celsius's bankruptcy estate sued five BitMEX entities in the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the Southern District of New York on Sept. 12 over BTC liquidated during the March 2020 crash; new reporting adds details about the XBTM20 leveraged derivative and Mashinsky's public denial of trading. BitMEX is set to stop trading Sept. 23.
threads.latest_update_zh: 新报道进一步披露 Celsius 在 BitMEX 上交易的是杠杆衍生品 XBTM20，并指出 Alex Mashinsky 在清算后一天公开声称 Celsius 不做交易，与债务人的指控相矛盾。
threads.latest_update_en: The new report further details that Celsius traded the leveraged derivative XBTM20 on BitMEX and that Alex Mashinsky publicly claimed one day after the liquidation that Celsius did not trade, contradicting the debtors' allegations.
threads.background_zh: Celsius's bankruptcy estate sued BitMEX for $495 million over the alleged wrongful liquidation and seizure of 6,360 BTC during the March 2020 crash, filing just 11 days before the exchange's shutdown.
threads.background_en: Celsius's bankruptcy estate sued BitMEX for $495 million over the alleged wrongful liquidation and seizure of 6,360 BTC during the March 2020 crash, filing just 11 days before the exchange's shutdown.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Celsius Network debtors sued BitMEX for over $100 million over alleged wrongful liquidation and seizure of Celsius BTC during the March 2020 COVID crash, contradicting CEO Alex Mashinsky's public claim that Celsius did not trade.
threads.latest_summary_en: Celsius Network debtors sued BitMEX for over $100 million over alleged wrongful liquidation and seizure of Celsius BTC during the March 2020 COVID crash, contradicting CEO Alex Mashinsky's public claim that Celsius did not trade.

threads.title_zh: Bitcoin activity, passports exposed after Revolut falls for fake government request
threads.title_en: Bitcoin activity, passports exposed after Revolut falls for fake government request
threads.summary_zh: Revolut 数据泄露事件出现赎金要求：名为“iamnotavillain”的攻击者索要300万美元门罗币并威胁出售被盗数据，但双方尚未谈判，Revolut 称未与攻击者联系或收到要求；路透社消息称约680名客户受影响。
threads.summary_en: A ransom demand has emerged in the Revolut data breach: attackers calling themselves "iamnotavillain" are demanding $3 million in Monero and threatening to sell stolen data, but no negotiations have begun and Revolut says it has had no contact or demands from the attackers; a Reuters source said about 680 customers were affected.
threads.latest_update_zh: 攻击者“iamnotavillain”声称对Revolut数据泄露负责，索要300万美元门罗币赎金，威胁若不支付将出售被盗客户数据；谈判尚未开始，Revolut称未收到任何要求；路透社称约680名客户受影响。
threads.latest_update_en: Attackers "iamnotavillain" claimed responsibility for the Revolut data breach and demanded $3 million in Monero ransom, threatening to sell stolen customer data if unpaid; negotiations have not begun, Revolut said it has received no demands; Reuters reported about 680 customers affected.
threads.background_zh: 作为提供类银行账户与加密交易服务的受监管金融科技公司，Revolut 必须依据“了解你的客户”（KYC）和反洗钱规则收集护照等身份文件，并用自拍照进行核验。这意味着单一服务商可能集中掌握大量身份文件，以及能把个人与其比特币持仓对应起来的交易历史。所谓“wrench attack”（扳手攻击），是指通过人身暴力或威胁来夺取受害者的加密资产，它绕开了密码学防护，直接针对人而非钱包，这类犯罪随着公众对“谁持有大量加密资产”的了解增加而不断上升。
threads.background_en: As a regulated fintech offering banking-style accounts and crypto trading, Revolut is required by know-your-customer (KYC) and anti-money-laundering rules to collect identity documents such as passports, and to verify them with a selfie. That means a single provider can hold a concentrated trove of identity documents plus the transaction history that maps a person to their Bitcoin holdings. A "wrench attack" refers to the use of physical force or intimidation to seize a victim's crypto assets, bypassing cryptography entirely by targeting the person instead of the wallet — a crime category that has grown alongside public knowledge of who holds large crypto positions.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Revolut is facing a $3 million Monero ransom demand from attackers claiming responsibility for a customer data breach, with threats to sell stolen data if unpaid.
threads.latest_summary_en: Revolut is facing a $3 million Monero ransom demand from attackers claiming responsibility for a customer data breach, with threats to sell stolen data if unpaid.
threads.discussion_zh: 链上调查员 ZachXBT 表示，此次泄露似乎针对的是高净值用户，进一步加剧了外界对“扳手攻击”的担忧；包括 Marc Zeller 在内的社交媒体批评者认为，这起事件说明 KYC 规则几乎没有带来实际好处，反而让许多用户陷入危险。
threads.discussion_en: Onchain investigator ZachXBT said the breach appeared to target high-net-worth users, fueling concern about wrench attacks; critics on social media, including Marc Zeller, argued the episode shows KYC rules have produced little upside while putting many users in harm's way.
threads.market_impact_zh: 传导路径主要是声誉与监管层面而非价格驱动：赎金索求本身不会推动 XMR 行情，但门罗币反复与敲诈勒索挂钩，会强化促使交易所下架隐私币的合规压力，从而影响 XMR 的流动性与可获取性。对 Revolut 而言，风险敞口来自用户信任以及监管机构对其数据处理和加密相关服务的潜在审查，情绪还会外溢至整个金融科技与加密的衔接领域。
threads.market_impact_en: The transmission path is mainly reputational and regulatory rather than price-driven: the demand itself does not move XMR markets, but recurring association of Monero with extortion reinforces the compliance pressure that has led exchanges to delist privacy coins, which affects XMR liquidity and access. For Revolut, exposure runs through user trust and potential regulatory scrutiny of its data-handling and crypto-adjacent services, with sentiment spillover to the broader fintech–crypto interface.

threads.title_zh: The US Bitcoin reserve faces a crucial bipartisan test Wednesday
threads.title_en: The US Bitcoin reserve faces a crucial bipartisan test Wednesday
threads.summary_zh: 《美国储备现代化法案》(ARMA, H.R. 8957) 已以 28-21 的投票结果通过众议院金融服务委员会，下一步需经众议院和参议院全体表决后才能递交总统签署。
threads.summary_en: The American Reserve Modernization Act (ARMA, H.R. 8957) passed the House Financial Services Committee 28-21 and must now pass the full House and Senate before reaching the president's desk.
threads.latest_update_zh: 美国众议院金融服务委员会以 28-21 的投票结果通过了《2026 年美国储备现代化法案》(H.R. 8957)，该法案将把特朗普的战略比特币储备编入法律，并要求联邦没收的比特币至少持有 20 年。
threads.latest_update_en: The House Financial Services Committee passed the American Reserve Modernization Act of 2026 (H.R. 8957) by a 28-21 vote, advancing the bill to codify Trump's strategic Bitcoin reserve and require federally forfeited Bitcoin to be held at least 20 years.
threads.background_zh: The House Financial Services Committee will mark up the American Reserve Modernization Act (ARMA), which would establish a federal Bitcoin reserve in statute, but the bill has only one Democratic cosponsor who does not sit on the committee.
threads.background_en: The House Financial Services Committee will mark up the American Reserve Modernization Act (ARMA), which would establish a federal Bitcoin reserve in statute, but the bill has only one Democratic cosponsor who does not sit on the committee.
threads.latest_summary_zh: The American Reserve Modernization Act of 2026 (H.R. 8957) passed the House Financial Services Committee 28-21, aiming to codify Trump's strategic Bitcoin reserve and lock federally forfeited Bitcoin for 20 years.
threads.latest_summary_en: The American Reserve Modernization Act of 2026 (H.R. 8957) passed the House Financial Services Committee 28-21, aiming to codify Trump's strategic Bitcoin reserve and lock federally forfeited Bitcoin for 20 years.

threads.title_zh: Federal Reserve Rate Hike Close To A Lock ; Clarity Act Vote Looms : Week Ahead
threads.title_en: Federal Reserve Rate Hike Close To A Lock ; Clarity Act Vote Looms : Week Ahead
threads.summary_zh: 美联储于2026年9月16日加息25个基点至3.75%-4.00%，为2023年7月以来首次加息，投票12-0一致；点阵图/中位数预测显示2026年底利率为4.1%，高于6月的3.8%；比特币在决议后冲高至76,499.99美元后半小时内回吐，随后稳定在约75,500美元附近，Zcash rally至1,383美元；主席沃什在发布会上称通胀是问题，并阐述美联储在AI政策上的独立性立场。
threads.summary_en: The Fed raised rates by 25 bps to 3.75%-4.00% on Sept 16, 2026, its first hike since July 2023, in a 12-0 vote; the median projection now puts the 2026 year-end rate at 4.1%, up from 3.8% in June; Bitcoin spiked to $76,499.99 after the release and gave back the move within half an hour, later stabilizing near $75,500, while Zcash rallied to $1,383; Chair Warsh called inflation 'the problem' and outlined the Fed's AI-policy independence stance.
threads.latest_update_zh: 新报道补充：FOMC以12-0将利率上调25个基点至3.75%-4%，并将2026年底利率中位数预测从6月的3.8%上调至4.1%；比特币在决议后五分钟内冲高至76,499.99美元，半小时内回吐全部涨幅；Zcash rally至1,383美元。
threads.latest_update_en: New report adds: FOMC voted 12-0 to raise rates 25 bps to 3.75%-4% and lifted the 2026 year-end median rate projection to 4.1% from 3.8% in June; Bitcoin spiked to $76,499.99 five minutes after the release and gave back the move within half an hour; Zcash rallied to $1,383.
threads.background_zh: 《Clarity法案》是一项两党立法，旨在为美国数字资产市场建立正式的监管框架，被普遍视为自《GENIUS法案》以来最重要的美国加密立法；其关键条款涉及代币如何分类、DeFi 与稳定币如何对待，以及加密交易所需要完成哪些注册义务。联邦基金利率是银行之间隔夜拆借准备金的利率，它锚定了全球市场的美元融资成本，这也是美联储决策会如此迅速地传导到风险资产的原因。此类“下周前瞻”文章会把联邦公开市场委员会决议、立法投票、财报等既定日程汇总起来，供交易者提前布局。
threads.background_en: The Clarity Act is bipartisan legislation designed to create a formal regulatory structure for digital asset markets in the United States, and it is widely described as the most significant US crypto legislation since the GENIUS Act; key provisions cover how tokens are classified, how DeFi and stablecoins are treated, and what crypto exchanges must do to register. The federal funds rate is the overnight rate at which banks lend reserve balances to each other, and it anchors dollar funding costs across global markets, which is why Fed decisions transmit so quickly into risk assets. A "week ahead" preview of this kind aggregates scheduled events — FOMC decisions, legislative votes, earnings — that traders position around in advance.
threads.latest_summary_zh: The FOMC unanimously raised rates a quarter point to 3.75%-4% and lifted its 2026 median projection to 4.1%, sending Bitcoin briefly to $76,499.99 before it round-tripped, while Zcash rallied to $1,383.
threads.latest_summary_en: The FOMC unanimously raised rates a quarter point to 3.75%-4% and lifted its 2026 median projection to 4.1%, sending Bitcoin briefly to $76,499.99 before it round-tripped, while Zcash rallied to $1,383.
threads.discussion_zh: 传导渠道是流动性与贴现率：更高的联邦基金利率和更鹰派的点阵图路径使美债与现金相对风险资产更具吸引力，从而对比特币和以太坊构成压力——两者在声明发布前后剧烈震荡，最终基本持平。美元、短端美债收益率、对利率敏感的股票板块以及加密衍生品资金费率是受影响最直接的领域，而偏鹰派的点阵图使2026年进一步加息成为影响仓位布局的潜在风险因素。
threads.discussion_en: The transmission runs through liquidity and the discount rate: higher fed funds and a higher dot-plot path make Treasuries and cash more attractive relative to risk assets, which pressures bitcoin and ether — both of which whipsawed around the announcement before settling roughly flat. The dollar, front-end Treasury yields, rate-sensitive equity sectors and crypto derivatives funding are the most directly exposed segments, while the hawkish dot keeps a further 2026 hike as a live risk factor for positioning.

threads.title_zh: Solana to triple transaction size as apps get room for more complex trades
threads.title_en: Solana to triple transaction size as apps get room for more complex trades
threads.summary_zh: Solana 已激活 Transaction V1，单笔交易数据容量提升三倍以上；250ms slot 时间缩减接近主网激活。
threads.summary_en: Solana has activated Transaction V1, tripling per-transaction data capacity; the reduction to 250ms slots is approaching mainnet activation.
threads.latest_update_zh: Solana 于 9 月 15 日激活 Transaction V1，将单笔交易数据容量扩大三倍以上至 4,096 字节，并准备将 slot 时间缩短至 250ms。
threads.latest_update_en: Solana activated Transaction V1 on Sept. 15, increasing per-transaction data capacity by more than threefold to 4,096 bytes, and is preparing to cut slot times to 250ms.
threads.background_zh: Solana 以固定长度的插槽来处理网络活动，每个插槽内由被调度的验证者有机会产出一个区块；最初的目标是每个插槽 400 毫秒，经过多次下调后已先后降至 350 毫秒和 300 毫秒。Solana 上的交易具有原子性——只要任何一部分失败，整笔交易就会失败——因此把更多操作打包进单笔交易，可以降低多步骤操作只完成一部分的风险。Anza 是专注于 Solana 的研发实验室，负责维护 Agave 验证者客户端；而当前性能路线图的最后一步是降到 200 毫秒插槽，该阶段已在开发网和测试网上运行，但尚未安排主网时间。
threads.background_en: Solana processes activity in fixed-length slots, during which a scheduled validator has the opportunity to produce a block; the original target was 400 milliseconds per slot, and successive reductions have taken it to 350ms and then 300ms. Transactions on Solana are atomic — if any part fails, the whole transaction fails — which is why bundling more operations into one transaction reduces the risk of partially completed multi-step actions. Anza is the Solana-focused research and development lab that maintains the Agave validator client, and the network's current performance roadmap ends with a final step down to 200ms slots, already live on devnet and testnet but not yet scheduled for mainnet.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Solana has activated Transaction V1, tripling per-transaction data capacity and preparing to cut slot times to 250ms as the network handles record transaction volumes across stablecoins, apps, and tokenized equities.
threads.latest_summary_en: Solana has activated Transaction V1, tripling per-transaction data capacity and preparing to cut slot times to 250ms as the network handles record transaction volumes across stablecoins, apps, and tokenized equities.
threads.discussion_zh: Solana 的容量与延迟表现直接影响 SOL 的竞争定位，以及驱动手续费销毁、质押需求和 DeFi 交易量的链上活动；更快、更大的交易对稳定币转账、DEX 交易和代币化股票等高频场景最为关键，而更紧的插槽窗口则抬高了验证者的硬件与带宽门槛，进而可能影响质押集中度和委托行为。支持 V1 格式滞后的钱包、交易所和 RPC 服务商，可能随着该格式普及而面临确认可靠性下降的问题。
threads.discussion_en: Solana's capacity and latency profile feeds directly into the competitive positioning of SOL and the on-chain activity that drives fee burn, staking demand, and DeFi volume; faster, larger transactions are most relevant to high-frequency segments such as stablecoin transfers, DEX trading, and tokenized equities, while tighter slot windows raise the hardware and bandwidth bar for validators, which can influence staking concentration and delegation behavior. Wallet, exchange, and RPC providers that lag in supporting the V1 format could see degraded confirmation reliability as adoption spreads.
threads.market_impact_zh: Solana 的容量与延迟表现直接影响 SOL 的竞争定位，以及驱动手续费销毁、质押需求和 DeFi 交易量的链上活动；更快、更大的交易对稳定币转账、DEX 交易和代币化股票等高频场景最为关键，而更紧的插槽窗口则抬高了验证者的硬件与带宽门槛，进而可能影响质押集中度和委托行为。支持 V1 格式滞后的钱包、交易所和 RPC 服务商，可能随着该格式普及而面临确认可靠性下降的问题。

threads.title_zh: Circle’s Arc launch ties Wall Street firms to the network without making them its safety net
threads.title_en: Circle’s Arc launch ties Wall Street firms to the network without making them its safety net
threads.summary_zh: Arc 区块链已于9月16日正式上线；主网以 USDC 为原生 gas，支持 EVM、亚秒级最终性、20 多种稳定币和 20 多条链互操作，并已完成 100 亿枚 ARC 代币创世铸造（但不代表承诺公开发行）。
threads.summary_en: The Arc blockchain is live following its Sept. 16 launch; the mainnet uses USDC as native gas, supports EVM, sub-second finality, 20+ stablecoins and 20+ blockchains via CCTP/Gateway, and has completed a genesis mint of 10 billion ARC tokens (though not a commitment to a public token launch).
threads.latest_update_zh: 新报道补充 Arc 主网技术细节：以 USDC 为原生 gas、EVM 兼容、亚秒级最终性、支持 20 多种法币稳定币与 20 多条链互操作，并披露本周完成 100 亿枚 ARC 代币创世铸造。
threads.latest_update_en: New report adds Arc mainnet technical details: USDC as native gas, EVM compatibility, sub-second finality, support for 20+ fiat stablecoins and 20+ blockchains via CCTP/Gateway, and disclosed a genesis mint of 10 billion ARC tokens this week.
threads.background_zh: Circle 是美元稳定币 USDC 的发行方，而 Arc 是它专为稳定币金融打造的 Layer-1 区块链，并与 USDC、CCTP 和 Gateway 深度集成。验证者是负责排序、验证和确认交易的节点，在权威证明（Proof-of-Authority）模式下需经过审核并获得许可，而非向任何人开放。DTCC 是美国的交易后市场基础设施，为证券提供清算与结算服务；BlackRock 的 BUIDL 则是一只代币化货币市场基金。
threads.background_en: Circle is the issuer of USDC, one of the largest dollar-denominated stablecoins, and Arc is a Layer-1 blockchain it built specifically for stablecoin finance, integrated with USDC, CCTP and Gateway. Validators are the nodes that order, verify and confirm transactions and, under Proof-of-Authority models, are vetted and permissioned rather than open to anyone. DTCC is the US post-trade market infrastructure that provides clearing and settlement services for securities, and BlackRock's BUIDL is a tokenized money-market fund.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Circle has launched the Arc mainnet, a USDC-gas L1 blockchain for stablecoin payments and financial markets with EVM compatibility, sub-second finality, and cross-chain interoperability.
threads.latest_summary_en: Circle has launched the Arc mainnet, a USDC-gas L1 blockchain for stablecoin payments and financial markets with EVM compatibility, sub-second finality, and cross-chain interoperability.
threads.discussion_zh: Arc 将机构级稳定币结算与代币化资产——BlackRock 的 BUIDL，以及未来通过目标于 2027 年下半年落地的 DTCC 集成引入的 DTC 托管资产——导入由 Circle 技术栈绑定的一套许可制验证者网络，这有可能把机构资金流引向以 USDC 计价的通道，并分流原本流向其他 L1 网络的流量。验证者投票权的集中度问题尚未解决，以及 Arc 计划向更广泛治理过渡，都是公开主网上线后市场参与者将关注的结构性变量。
threads.discussion_en: Arc channels institutional stablecoin settlement and tokenized assets — BlackRock's BUIDL, and eventually DTC-custodied assets via a DTCC integration targeted for the second half of 2027 — onto a permissioned validator set tied to Circle's stack, which could pull institutional flow toward USDC-denominated rails and away from competing L1 networks. The unresolved concentration of validator voting power and Arc's planned transition toward broader governance are structural variables market participants will watch once the public mainnet is live.
threads.market_impact_zh: Arc 将机构级稳定币结算与代币化资产——BlackRock 的 BUIDL，以及未来通过目标于 2027 年下半年落地的 DTCC 集成引入的 DTC 托管资产——导入由 Circle 技术栈绑定的一套许可制验证者网络，这有可能把机构资金流引向以 USDC 计价的通道，并分流原本流向其他 L1 网络的流量。验证者投票权的集中度问题尚未解决，以及 Arc 计划向更广泛治理过渡，都是公开主网上线后市场参与者将关注的结构性变量。

The unresolved concentration of validator voting power and Arc's planned transition toward broader governance are structural variables market participants will watch once the public mainnet is live.

threads.title_zh: Republicans Post Final CLARITY Act Text With Trump-Backed Ethics Terms a Day Before Cloture Vote
threads.title_en: Republicans Post Final CLARITY Act Text With Trump-Backed Ethics Terms a Day Before Cloture Vote
threads.summary_zh: 参议院未能推进CLARITY Act，终结辩论投票以49-50失败，该法案在2026年的前景基本结束；市场反应为比特币ETF大幅净流出，但法案后续仍可能通过其他立法或SEC/CFTC规则制定推进。
threads.summary_en: The Senate failed to advance the CLARITY Act after a 49-50 cloture vote, effectively ending its chances in 2026; the market reaction included sharp Bitcoin ETF outflows, though the bill could still be revived or addressed via SEC/CFTC rulemaking.
threads.latest_update_zh: 参议院以49-50未能通过CLARITY Act的终结辩论投票，该法案在2026年实际上已无望推进；同日美国现货比特币ETF录得4.504亿美元净流出，为6月24日以来最大单日流出。
threads.latest_update_en: The Senate failed to invoke cloture on the CLARITY Act by a 49-50 vote, effectively ending its chances in 2026; the same day U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs saw $450.4 million in net outflows, their worst day since June 24.
threads.background_zh: Republicans released the final CLARITY Act text, revising ethics terms by removing the January 20, 2029 sunset, reversing the July bar on state attorney general enforcement, and raising civil penalties to 20% of the take or $500,000, whichever is greater, ahead of a Senate cloture vote.
threads.background_en: Republicans released the final CLARITY Act text, revising ethics terms by removing the January 20, 2029 sunset, reversing the July bar on state attorney general enforcement, and raising civil penalties to 20% of the take or $500,000, whichever is greater, ahead of a Senate cloture vote.

threads.latest_summary_en: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs saw $450.4 million in net outflows—their worst day since June 24—after the Senate failed to advance the Clarity Act crypto market-structure bill in a 49-50 cloture vote.

threads.title_zh: Coinbase CLARITY Act: Senate Cloture Vote Explained - Cryptonews
threads.title_en: Coinbase CLARITY Act: Senate Cloture Vote Explained - Cryptonews
threads.summary_zh: 参议院终结辩论投票失败，CLARITY Act未获推进，美国数字资产市场结构立法搁置，监管继续依赖SEC与CFTC规则。
threads.summary_en: The Senate cloture vote failed, the CLARITY Act was not advanced, and US digital-asset market-structure legislation is stalled, leaving oversight to SEC and CFTC rules.
threads.latest_update_zh: 参议院程序性动议未能达到60票终结辩论门槛，CLARITY Act推进失败，法案搁置；消息公布后Coinbase等加密股大幅下跌。
threads.latest_update_en: The Senate procedural motion failed to reach the 60-vote cloture threshold, stalling the CLARITY Act; crypto equities fell sharply, with Coinbase down nearly 9%.
threads.background_zh: 在美国参议院，大多数立法需要 60 票才能结束辩论并进入表决程序——即参议院第 22 条规则下的“终结辩论”（cloture）机制——因此一项法案即便能以简单多数通过，也可能被程序性拦下。《Clarity Act》正式名称为《数字资产市场清晰法案》，是此前 FIT21 立法努力的继任者，其核心是把数字资产的监管权在 SEC 与 CFTC 之间进行划分，明确哪些代币属于证券、哪些属于商品。在缺乏此类成文法的情况下，美国加密监管一直依赖监管机构对自身既有权限的解释，包括源自 1946 年最高法院判例的 Howey 测试。欧盟的《加密资产市场条例》（MiCA）则是企业用来对比的主要替代性规则体系。
threads.background_en: In the US Senate, most legislation needs 60 votes to end debate and proceed — a mechanism called cloture under Senate Rule 22 — so a bill can be blocked even if it would pass with a simple majority. The Clarity Act, formally the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act, is the successor to the earlier FIT21 effort and would divide oversight of digital assets between the SEC and the CFTC, defining which tokens count as securities and which as commodities. In the absence of such a statute, US crypto oversight has relied on regulators' interpretation of their existing authority, including the Howey test derived from a 1946 Supreme Court ruling. The European Union's Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) regulation is the main alternative rulebook that companies compare against.
threads.latest_summary_zh:
周二，推动《数字资产市场清晰法案》（H.R.3633）的程序性动议未能达到参议院终结辩论所需的 60 票门槛，这项美国迄今最全面的数字资产市场结构立法因此搁置。消息公布后加密相关股票大幅下跌，Coinbase 跌幅接近 9%。

这次投票是该行业把市场结构规则写入成文法、而非交由监管机构自由裁量的最佳机会，因此失败意味着美国加密监管仍将依赖 SEC 与 CFTC 的规则，而未来的政府可以随时改写这些规则。这种“持久性”缺口会持续给面向美国市场的公司带来压力，并可能推动更多投资与开发流向已经通过 MiCA 提供更清晰规则的欧盟等司法辖区。

该法案此前已于 2026 年 5 月在参议院银行委员会以 15 比 9 的两党票数获得通过，参议员 Cynthia Lummis 也在 2026 年 7 月发布了更新版本，因此这次挫折属于程序性失败（终结辩论投票），而非对法案本身实质内容的否决。业内人士强调，SEC 的《加密资产监管条例》征求意见程序，以及 CFTC 依据现行《商品交易法》授权起草市场结构制度的工作，从未取决于周二的投票结果。
threads.latest_summary_en:
On Tuesday, a procedural motion to advance the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act (H.R.3633) failed to reach the Senate's 60-vote cloture threshold, stalling the most comprehensive US digital-asset market-structure bill to date. Crypto equities fell sharply on the news, with Coinbase sliding nearly 9%.

This vote was the industry's best chance to lock market-structure rules into statute rather than leave them to agency discretion, so its failure means US crypto oversight continues to rest on SEC and CFTC rules that a future administration can rewrite. That durability gap keeps pressure on US-facing firms and could push more investment and development toward jurisdictions such as the EU, where MiCA already provides a clearer rulebook.

The bill had already cleared the Senate Banking Committee on a 15-9 bipartisan vote in May 2026, with updated text released by Senator Cynthia Lummis in July 2026, so the setback was procedural (cloture) rather than a rejection on the merits. Industry figures stressed that the SEC's Regulation Crypto Assets comment process and the CFTC's drafting of a market-structure regime under existing Commodity Exchange Act authority were never contingent on Tuesday's vote.
threads.discussion_zh: 业内反应尖锐但总体克制：Ripple 首席执行官 Brad Garlinghouse 表示“这一次真的很痛”，呼吁进行事后复盘，并指责民主党的政治算计被置于良好政策之上，同时强调 Ripple 的业务势头以及 SEC/CFTC 的规则制定路径依然完好。Enso 联合创始人兼首席执行官 Connor Howe 则认为，未能达到 60 票门槛并不会把市场打回 2022 年，但“持久性”恰恰是这次投票的关键所在，因为未来的监管机构主席无需任何参议院投票就能改写机构规则。
threads.discussion_en: Industry reaction was pointed but notably measured: Ripple CEO Brad Garlinghouse said "This one stings," called for a post-mortem and blamed Democratic politics being elevated over good policy, while arguing that Ripple's business momentum and the SEC/CFTC rulemaking path remain intact. Enso co-founder and CEO Connor Howe argued the miss does not send the market back to 2022, but that durability is exactly where the vote matters, since a future chair can rewrite an agency rule without any Senate vote.
threads.market_impact_zh: 最直接的传导渠道是上市加密概念股，相关股票在消息公布后立即遭到抛售，Coinbase 下跌近 9%；与此同时，代币以及面向美国市场的交易场所仍要面对“哪些资产属于证券、哪些平台可以注册”这些悬而未决的问题。这次失败还相对提升了在欧盟 MiCA 框架下运营的交易场所与发行方的吸引力，从而在更长的时间维度上影响流动性与上币活动的聚集地。
threads.market_impact_en: The most direct transmission is through listed crypto equity proxies, which sold off immediately — Coinbase fell nearly 9% — while tokens and US-facing trading venues remain exposed to unresolved questions over which assets are securities and which venues may register. The failure also tilts the relative attractiveness of venues and issuers operating under the EU's MiCA framework, affecting where liquidity and listings concentrate over time.
